newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Yemeni premier says his country sought international observers for April's election.
- President of the Jeddah-based Islamic Development Bank says his bank seeks investment alliance with the Islamic private sector in Asia.
- Oman's trade surplus improves, balance of payment deficit decreased.
- Iran's third submarine to leave Russia for Tehran in days.
- Saudi Arabia's industrial sales in 1995 were worth 70 billion riyals.
- Saudi Manhal company plans to build two water plants in Beirut and Cairo.
